description: Start a cart to build up step by step (or use start_checkout to buy in one call); no account needed. Pass items [{variant_id, quantity}] to fill it at once. Returns cart_id, version, a quote (prices, free delivery, total) and, for guests, a private guest_token: pass guest_token on every later call and never share it.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

items.description: Optional: start the cart with these items (up to 20 variants), instead of calling set_cart_item for each. A variant listed twice is added together.

name: create_cart
